overclaims: LeCun's world-model approach will not solve many of the problems that have plagued LLMs.
Plain reading: LeCun's world-model approach (JEPA, pursued at AMI Labs) will not fix many known LLM problems, such as hallucination, unreliable reasoning or poor generalization.
LeCun's company, AMI Labs, launched in March 2026 with about $1 billion in seed funding.
No public results by the evaluation date show its JEPA approach solving, or failing to solve, the known problems of LLMs.
No decisive results were expected or found by the evaluation date.
checks.note: The categorical proposition and interpretation strengthen Marcus's hedged expectation. The evidence dates founding to December 2025 and funding coverage to March 2026; it does not establish a March launch. A search finding no evaluations does not establish their absence. A five-year saleable-product timeline does not establish when decisive research results were expected. The unresolved outcome and citation metadata match.
